dod.D0_census: Static active-import census and rendered browser census reconcile the active experience; every visible semantic node is inventoried.
dod.D1_truth: At least 95% of all visible semantic nodes and 100% of critical nodes have >=0.95 classification confidence; fake=0 and unknown critical=0.
dod.D2_cognitive: One orientation authority per surface; decision content precedes evidence/detail/technical material; disclosure depth <=2.
dod.D3_interaction: One primary action, at most three support actions, at most four primary facts, 44px targets, keyboard/accessibility names, bounded queue navigation.
dod.D4_epistemic: Runtime/derived/static/compatibility truth is explicit; AI is proposal-only; evidence and decision authority remain distinct; scope/mapping/compliance and completed/closed remain distinct.
dod.D5_runtime: No new presentation authority; primitives are idempotent under lifecycle replay and browser journeys preserve runtime effects.
dod.D6_assurance: 10,000,000 deterministic unit semantic mutations are detected across compliance, GRC, cognitive ergonomics, accessibility, simplicity and progressive disclosure; exact-head CI is green.
